title: Following the Flow the Law Requires: Training Voice Agents to Transfer to Unseen Regulated Procedures in Debt Collection
abstract: arXiv:2610.18881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Voice agents built on large language models (LLMs) now handle customer calls, but in regulated applications completing the task is not enough: the agent must follow a conversational flow set by law. In debt collection, it must confirm it is speaking to the debtor before mentioning the debt, identify itself and the creditor, state the amount, and avoid prohibited language. Every creditor turns these rules into its own procedure and revises it. We ask whether a small, self-hosted policy can be trained once and then follow regulated procedures it has never seen. One machine-readable specification per deployment, FlowSpec, generates the policy instruction, gates the tools, supplies the supervision and defines the tests; the agent speaks only approved catalogue sentences. translated_title: 遵循法律规定的流程：训练语音代理迁移至未见过的受监管债务催收程序
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的语音代理如今可以处理客户来电，但在受监管的应用场景中，仅仅完成任务是不够的：代理必须遵循由法律设定的对话流程。在债务催收中，代理必须在提及债务之前先确认自己正在与债务人通话，表明自身和债权人的身份，说明欠款金额，并避免使用被禁止的语言。每个债权人都会将这些规则转化为自己的流程程序，并不断进行修订。本文探究的核心问题是：能否只训练一次一个小型、自托管的策略模型，然后让它遵循从未见过的受监管程序。每个部署使用一份机器可读的规范 FlowSpec，由它生成策略指令、控制工具调用、提供监督信号并定义测试；代理只能说出经过批准的目录句子。研究团队在来自 297 个随机化程序的 2,506 段对话上微调了一个 90 亿参数的模型，并在四个未见过的部署程序上评估了一个泰语外呼代理（原摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出 FlowSpec 机器可读规范，通过在 297 个随机化监管程序上微调 90 亿参数模型，训练出能够零样本遵循从未见过的受监管债务催收流程的语音代理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FlowSpec, a machine-readable specification that enables a 9-billion-parameter voice agent fine-tuned on 297 randomized procedures to follow unseen regulated debt-collection conversational flows required by law.
